verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Teams developer platform: the Microsoft Graph REST API for Teams, an agent quickstart, a Slack Bolt porting guide (title only), and the Agents Toolkit CLI with templates. No item names or describes an official SDK or client library for any language. The REST API and CLI belong to separate stories and are adjacent, so they earn no credit for an official-SDK story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
